room_description: Walls are painted a warm off-white/cream color with a slight yellow undertone. Floor is low-pile carpet in a medium grey-beige tone. Ceiling is flat white with a central ceiling fan/light fixture partially visible at top. Large central window on the back wall with horizontal venetian blinds in a warm tan/gold color, backlit by strong natural daylight creating a warm yellow glow. Two additional smaller window areas flank the central window. Room is wide and rectangular — a typical double or triple occupancy college dormitory layout. Built-in oak-toned wooden desk units line both side walls and the back wall under the window, with matching oak-frame loft-style beds. Natural light enters primarily from the back wall center, casting soft diffused shadows forward into the room.

replacement_descriptions.dark patterned comforter on left bed: A neatly folded, minimalist linen duvet in warm oatmeal-beige with a very subtle woven texture, laid flat and tucked cleanly. 100% stonewashed linen fabric, slightly rumpled in an intentional wabi-sabi manner, natural undyed tone. Complemented by a single cylindrical buckwheat bolster pillow in muted sage green linen. The linen tone harmonizes with the warm oak wood frame and cream walls.
replacement_descriptions.white comforter on foreground bed: A precisely folded Japanese-style shikibuton-inspired cotton duvet in warm ivory with a fine grid-stitch quilting pattern, laid smoothly over the bed. Natural cotton percale weave, off-white with the faintest warm grey undertone. Single flat pillow in natural undyed cotton. Clean edges, no excess draping, Japandi aesthetic of quiet restraint.
replacement_descriptions.grey comforter and bedding on right bed: A layered Japandi bedding set — base sheet in warm white cotton, topped with a lightweight charcoal-grey waffle-knit cotton blanket folded at the foot third of the bed. One low-profile pillow in natural linen. The charcoal grey grounds the warm oak tones and cream walls while maintaining the cool-warm Japandi balance.
replacement_descriptions.black gaming office chair on right side: A Japandi-style accent chair with a solid white oak frame featuring tapered, slightly angled legs with a matte natural finish. Seat and back upholstered in thick natural boucle fabric in warm greige. Low back, clean silhouette, no armrests. Brass-tone metal connector detail at leg joints. The natural wood echoes the built-in oak desk units and the warm natural light from the window.
replacement_descriptions.black office chair at center desk: A minimalist task stool in Japandi style — solid white oak legs with a subtle inward taper, round padded seat cushion upholstered in dark charcoal linen fabric with a matte finish. No back support, low profile. Smooth matte oak finish complements the built-in oak desk. Positioned neatly at the desk suggesting organized intentionality.
replacement_descriptions.black computer monitor on center desk: Replace with a single ultra-slim frameless monitor in a matte warm white casing, set on a minimal solid oak monitor riser block — a simple rectangular plank of lightly oiled white oak, 5cm height. Clean cable management. The warm oak riser ties the tech element into the existing oak desk infrastructure.
replacement_descriptions.cardboard box behind center desk: Remove entirely. Replace with a tall, slender washi paper floor lamp with a slim matte black iron pole and a cylindrical washi paper shade in warm off-white. The warm diffused glow of the washi shade layers beautifully with the backlit venetian blinds, adding ambient depth to the window alcove.
replacement_descriptions.scattered shoes on floor center: Replace with a low-profile solid oak shoe tray — a flat rectangular tray in lightly oiled natural white oak, 5cm high side rails, sitting flush on the carpet near the door wall. Houses two or three pairs of shoes aligned neatly. The oak matches the built-in furniture units throughout the room.
replacement_descriptions.black backpacks and bags on floor: Replace with a single large woven seagrass storage basket with a flat lid, in a natural honey-beige tone. Approximately 40cm diameter, 50cm tall. Slightly irregular weave pattern adds wabi-sabi texture. Placed against the wall to clear floor space and maintain the calm visual field central to Japandi design.
replacement_descriptions.clothes and items scattered on floor rig: Remove entirely. Replace with a slim solid white oak valet stand — minimal A-frame structure, single horizontal bar for folded items, small tray hook at top. Matte natural oil finish. Represents the Japandi value of a designated place for every object, reducing visual noise.
replacement_descriptions.plastic bags and clutter on floor right: Remove entirely. Surface replaced with clean visible carpet, optionally with a small rectangular jute rug in natural tan placed beside the right bed, 60x90cm, hand-woven texture with a simple fringe edge.
replacement_descriptions.framed posters on right wall: Replace with two minimalist Japandi-style art pieces. Left piece: a vertical framed botanical ink study — single dried pampas grass stem on warm ivory washi paper, thin solid oak frame with matte finish, 30x40cm. Right piece: an abstract sumi-e ink wash painting with soft grey brushstrokes suggesting mountains, on cream washi paper, matching thin oak frame. Both hang with equal spacing, centered on the wall panel.
replacement_descriptions.dark framed poster on back wall: Replace with a single wide horizontal framed piece — a muted watercolor landscape in warm grey and warm beige tones suggesting a foggy forest, printed on textured cotton rag paper, housed in a flat wide white oak frame with a deep matte finish, 60x40cm. Positioned centered on the wall panel above the desk unit.
replacement_descriptions.miscellaneous desk surface items left: Replace with curated Japandi desk accessories — one small konara oak pen holder with natural grain visible, one A5 open notebook with kraft paper cover, one smooth river stone paperweight in dark grey, arranged with deliberate negative space. Clean and purposeful.
replacement_descriptions.miscellaneous desk surface items right: Replace with a small ceramic bud vase in matte off-white with a wabi-sabi irregular rim, holding a single dried eucalyptus sprig. Beside it, a small square ceramic tray in matte warm grey holding one mechanical pencil and one eraser. Calm, intentional arrangement that reflects Japandi minimalism.
replacement_descriptions.blue water bottle and bottles on right d: Replace with a single tall handblown glass carafe in warm amber-tinted glass, with a small ceramic cup in matte warm sand. The amber glass catches the warm backlit window light beautifully.
replacement_descriptions.energy drink can and plastic bottles on: Replace with a small matte white ceramic oil diffuser, compact cylindrical form, beside a single small succulent plant in a rough terracotta pot with a matte white glaze exterior. Grounded, natural, calm.

lighting_analysis: Primary light source is strong natural daylight entering through the large central back wall window with venetian blinds partially diffusing the light into a warm golden-yellow tone, approximately 4000-5000K but filtered to appear warmer at around 3200-3500K through the tan blinds. Light projects forward from the back wall casting long soft shadows toward the camera (southward into the room). Secondary ambient light from overhead ceiling fixture appears off or minimal. Left wall receives warm indirect bounce light from window. Right wall is slightly cooler and more shadowed. Shadow direction: forward and slightly left, soft-edged due to diffusion through blinds. Overall exposure is moderately bright in the center-back zone with gentle falloff toward the foreground and side walls.
